ideas.verdict: Rejected: 4h net Sharpe -1.27 (CI -2.64..0.12), -14%/yr Jul 2024-Nov 2026 (gross 0.67 eaten by 22%/yr costs); round grids no better than shifted grids (placebo p 0.50); daily -0.30.

ideas.name: AdaptiveTrend: monthly-tuned momentum + ATR trailing stops, last month's best systems, 70/30 long/short
ideas.source: Bui & Nguyen, 'AdaptiveTrend: Systematic Trend-Following with Adaptive Portfolio Construction', arXiv 2602.11708 (2026) - https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.11708
ideas.rule: 4h bars; enter when L-bar return > theta (short < -theta), exit through alpha x ATR14 trailing stop; each month grid-search (L, theta, alpha) per coin/side on the previous month, keep longs with Sharpe >= 1.3 among the 15 most traded coins and shorts >= 1.7 among the 15 least traded; 70% long / 30% short
ideas.verdict: Rejected: did not replicate - 4h net Sharpe -0.3 (CI -1.68..1.04), -10.4%/yr, DD 45.2% Aug 2024-Nov 2026, placebo p 0.448; daily -0.11 2020-2026 with DD 89.5%; the monthly retune + Sharpe filter hurt (daily fixed-parameter control 0.64).
